target.name: Lazard World Dividend & Income Fund, Inc.

acquirer.name: Lazard Global Total Return and Income Fund, Inc.

listed_quote.quote: Lazard World Dividend & Income Fund, Inc. (NYSE: LOR) and Lazard Global Total Return and Income Fund, Inc. (NYSE: LGI)

announcement.quote: As a result of the foregoing, management recommended to the Board that LOR be merged with and into LGI. The Board recommends that you vote FOR the Reorganization.

deals.notes: On 2019-10-18 (accession 0000930413-19-002701) LGI adjourned its annual meeting on the Merger Proposal to November 15, 2019. Later excerpts (2019-11-12 DEFA14A, 2020 and 2021 DEF 14A and DEFA14A) show only their first lines, so no filing in front of me states how the merger ended.
